picks.name: Shin Watanabe
picks.bio: "RED ZONE-ETHOS MAMA TRAX" (May 1, 2026) is a sprawling 13-track 2xLP on L.I.E.S. Records, gathering Watanabe's Red Zone and Ethos Mama Trax series into one release.
picks.why_listen: A big, varied dose of deep house from a prolific L.I.E.S. regular -- plenty of material to pull individual tools from for different points in a set.

picks.name: Stones Taro
picks.source_note: Already in your library; new release on Rhythm Section International.
picks.bio: Taro Nakano, already in your library, who also heads up the NC4K label. "Odoriko" (July 24, 2026) is his Rhythm Section debut -- five tracks: Odoriko (feat. MFS), Goat, Just A Little Bit, Out Of Cycle, Silk.
picks.why_listen: New material from an artist already in your rotation, landing on a label with a strong track record (see Sam Goku, already featured) -- worth getting ahead of.

picks.name: Kyle Hall
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Smooth Architecture" (June 1, 2026) is a self-released track -- lovely rhythmic composition, mellow jazz voicings over saw-wave basslines, warm and groovy throughout.
picks.why_listen: A fresh cut from an artist already in your rotation -- softer and jazzier than his rawer Detroit output, good for a warmer moment in a set.
